nativeBuild.purpose: Original development-only warm PNG FFmpeg worker

receipt.boundary: Warm identical PNG bytes to independent owned RGBA pixels: public managed Decode/allocation/disposal; native codec/input packet/frame wrappers reused, complete decode/owned output/release. RGBA16 BE-to-LE, RGB48BE-to-RGBA64LE, GRAY16BE-to-RGBA64LE, YA16BE-to-RGBA64LE, RGB24-to-RGBA, GRAY8-to-RGBA, MONOBLACK-to-RGBA, YA8-to-RGBA or PAL8-to-RGBA FFmpeg conversion and second output allocation included natively; direct RGBA8 requires no conversion. For gray1/key1, the existing SPEC colorkey=white:similarity=0.01:blend=0 correction follows full MONOBLACK-to-RGBA conversion inside timing; the conversion buffer is transferred for in-place filtering and the owned filtered output is released. Native padded rows exposed directly; packing/file IO/IPC/hashes excluded.
